fields.summary_ko.0: Applied Materials (NASDAQ:AMAT) declined 29% over the past month to $381.01 but is up 49% year-to-date, with Q3 earnings on November 12 likely to be a trigger for recovery or further decline.
fields.summary_ko.1: Competitor Lam Research (NASDAQ:LRCX) declined 34% over the month to $229.50, and KLA (NASDAQ:KLAC) fell 25% to $155.06, showing broad semiconductor equipment weakness.
fields.summary_ko.2: The company has set targets of 54% non-GAAP gross margin and 40% operating margin by 2030, with Applied Global Services revenue expected to exceed $12 billion by 2030.
